$comment: Canonical merged movement corpus. One record per movement, with every contributing source named per record so provenance survives the merge and the licence question stays answerable later. Merge order is wdl-curated > garmin > free-exercise-db > everkinetic; earlier sources win on conflicting scalar fields, and set-valued fields (muscles, equipment, aliases) are unioned.
licenceWarning: Mixed provenance. everkinetic is CC-BY-SA 4.0, Garmin's catalogue carries no stated licence, free-exercise-db is public domain. See SOURCES.md before redistributing.
